emergency_details: Fire involving the loading arm of Bay 21 at Gantry 3 which accidentally caught fire while loading the second compartment of a tanker with Reg. No. T16466LA belonging to KRD. Energy driven by one Mr Oluwule Micheal.
action_taken: On arrival the fire crew immediately put off the fire with the use of 3 foam monitors surrounding the Bay.
closure_notes: After fire was put out, the Tanker driver had a 2nd-Degree Burn and was taking to the medical center. All clear was decleared by the RSM. Fire crew and appliances return to their respective station standby.

emergency_details: Flash fire reported at 3:20am by KOINS team removing floating head cover of 113-EE-1002C. ( HP Trim condenser) 113-EE-1002 A,B and D were removed without any incident. Suspected cause is pyrophoric fire. Water flushing was done on the exchanger floating head cover and this water connected to prevent a recurrence.
action_taken: Out on the arrival of fire crew by the plant field officer but the fire crew monitored as the plant operators removed 113-EE-1002 A,B & D.
closure_notes: After the water flushing was done on the exchanger floating head cover connected successfully to prevent a recurrence, the fire crew return to their station stnadby.

emergency_details: Fire during hot job at plant battery limit. Job was MOC related job executed during plant shutdown. Post incident information to Fire Service
action_taken: Out on the arrival of fire crew by the plant field officer but the fire crew stayed and monitored as the plant operators drained the lines, purged with nitrogen and steamed prior to mechanical cutting.
closure_notes: After the hot work activities, the fire crew return to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire confined to the flanges of a reactor 152-RB-1001 reactor number one radian flow.
action_taken: On arrival, the fire crew immediately put off the fire with 9kg DCP fire extingisher.
closure_notes: After the fire was put off, SFS-2 crew remain on standby while the rest of the crew reurn to their station standby.

emergency_details: A flash fire that occurred during CT-02 CW return header valve modification job.
action_taken: During the puncher of line minor spark observed and extinguished itself before the arrival of the fire crew.
closure_notes: Line flushed further and drained completely through the puncture. Gas testing was performed to ensure no hydrocarbon vapors. After this process, the crew then return to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire from train 2 effluent recycle gas exchanger with tag number 122-EE-1004 caused by a leakage of diesel from the effluent flange on an insulation of about 280 to 300 degree C.
action_taken: On arrival the fire crew immediately put off the fire using 2 lines of hose from hydrant connected with trolley monitor.
closure_notes: After the fire was put off, All crew and applainces return to their station standby. In attandance were the RSM, MHC SIC, MHC OPERATION TEAM AND FIRE CREW.

emergency_details: Fire from the CCR reactor reduction zone flange.
action_taken: Out on the arrival of fire crew by the plant field officer with DCP fire extinguisher.
closure_notes: On getting to the scene the fire team observed the area for any possible reoccrances.A lecture was also given to the plant operational team on "corrective and preventive measures".

emergency_details: Smoke from a burning cable wire caused by scavenger activity.
action_taken: Out before the arrival of the fire crew by the site officals.
closure_notes: After a round checking of the area, the fire carefuly obsereved the area and made sure there was no sing of reoccurance before returning to their respective station standby.

emergency_details: A flash fire caused by hydrocarbon pocket in 24inches line from the flange of the high pressure receiver (102-VV-1004) outlet line during hot job by Energio contractors.
action_taken: Out before the arrival of the fire crew by Energio contractors with the use of 6kg fire extinguisher. On arrival of the fire crew, they line a 2.5inches delivery hose and hose reel using 1000gpm foam monitor to cool the environment.
closure_notes: After the cooling of the environment, the fire extinguisher used by the contractors were replaced and a gas test was conducted by the crew, which results are as follows; LEL:18%, & CO:722PPM. All clear was decleared by the RSM, men with their applainces return to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire from the 16inch flange of 121-EE-1004 train 2 effluent recycle gas outlet exchanger.
action_taken: On arrival of the crew they immediately deployed two 1000gpm fixed monitor, which was used to put off the fire.
closure_notes: After a round checking of the area, all crew return to their station standby.

emergency_details: Minor fire occurred at the out board of MC O/H pump 112-PA1014B due to the welding spark from fin fan area (contractor M/s God Grace Permit number 48923). The spark originated from 112-EE1011 A-P platform errection job location. The spark fallen on out board (O/B) of 112-PA1014 B MC O/H pump. There was slight hydrocarbon seal leak from pump out board side and fire occurred.
action_taken: Fire was out before the arrival of the crew by Operational staff Mr Mohammed Mohgad PE 90002221, and Maintenance supervisor Thanraj. Gopi using DCP Fire Extinguisher.
closure_notes: All clear was decleared after investigation was done and all area was calm. All crew including DPRP ambulance return to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire from the MOV flange caused by a rise in temperature which led to leakage and ignition.
action_taken: Out before thr arrival of the fire the crew by the operational team using a 9kg DCP fire extinguisher.
closure_notes: After the fire was put off, the MOV was shut to isolate the line and nitrogen lancing was introduced to prevent re-ignition. The fire crew return to their station standby after the area was cool.

emergency_details: A smoke detected by a flame detector 171-FD-25001 which was as result of high temperature from the electric surface heater compressor.
action_taken: On arrival of the crew they immediately made use of a 9kg DCP Fire extinguisher to cool the temperature of the electric compressor after the line was isolated.
closure_notes: All clear was decleared by the plant SIC and the fire crew observed the environment which was cool and calm before returning to their station for standby.

emergency_details: Minor fire due to overheated electric kettle. Kettle kept ON while closing the office. Morning, housekeeping staff observed smoke in the room with metled kettle body and charred table
action_taken: The fire crew went for inspection immediately it was reported by the staff in the early hours of resumption to duty.
closure_notes: After the invetigations, the fire crew find out what happened and educate the adim staff the important of safety before proceeding to their standby station.

emergency_details: During unit start-up, equipment 112 EE-1008E was brought online following the warm-up period. At approximately 16:30 hours, a flash fire and subsequent smoke emission were observed originating from the insulation on the channel head of 112-EE-1008E.The incident was likely caused by soaked insulation, which ignited upon exposure to elevated temperatures.
action_taken: The flash fire was contained by the immediate application of water and a steam lancer was promptly deployed to control and suppress the fire.
closure_notes: The area was monitored, and all personnel were confirmed safe. The crew immediately withdrew to a safe distance, and firewater was applied to extinguish the localized flame, which was quickly brought under control

emergency_details: During unit start-up, equipment 112-PA-1006A suction strainer at 05:00 hrs was opened for cleaning. At approximately 05:00 hours, a flash fire and subsequent smoke emission were observed originating from the insulation of 112-PA-1006A suction strainer bucket upstream MOV. The incident was likely caused by soaked insulation, which ignited upon exposure to elevated temperatures
action_taken: The flash fire was contained by the immediate application of water and a steam lancer was promptly deployed to control and suppress the fire.
closure_notes: The area was monitored, and all personnel were confirmed safe. The crew immediately withdrew to a safe distance, and firewater was applied to extinguish the localized flame, which was quickly brought under control.

emergency_details: A fire outbreak emanated from a dumped particles at the south side of SRR-02 of RFCC plant.
action_taken: On arrival,the Fire team met the security personnel and plant operators making use of three fire extinguishers to contained the fire before fire team compelety put out the fire with the use of one line of hose reel working from FT-04.
closure_notes: After the all clear declearation by the RSM,the fire team retrieved the three fire extinguisher used by the security personnel and plant operators and took them to the main fire station for replacemnt and the team enroute to their respective standby locations.

emergency_details: A smoke detected by the multi smoke detector CR07- MD- 01/004 at the electrical room of CR- 07 which was as a result of fire from the electrical Panel.
action_taken: On arrival of the fire team,a 5kg CO2 fire extinguisher was used immediately to put out the fire.
closure_notes: After the fire had been put out and the SIC declear all clear,the fire team observed the area for about 20 minutes to ensure that everywhere is cool and calm before departing the scene to their station.

emergency_details: A minor fire caused by an oil dripping on a hot pipeline at the Expander-02 Area. The Fire was a insulation fire (Lagging Fire) due to condensed vapour from Bearing housing breather. The oil vapour release over time through the vent condensed and falling over the insulation of turbine. Due to temperature of turbine, the oil disintegrated and finally caught fire.
action_taken: Two units of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher was used to put out the fire by the operation team before the arrival of the fire team.
closure_notes: In addition to safety measures, one fire personnel and one operation personnel were detailed for close monitoring before the arrival of the maintenance team for proper ratification.

emergency_details: A fire involving a cat dump caterpillar with number 04 driven by Mr Olufowobi , which reported accidentally caught fire while loading,the affected engine compartment slightly damaged by fire
action_taken: One FFFP foam from Fertilizer fire appliance was used to extinguished the fire before the arrival of the Refinery fire team.
closure_notes: After the fire had been put out and a 360 assessement of the vehicle and surrounding was made by the two fire team on ground, 22k crew with FT-05 and the shift lead with ERT-01 proceeded to their respective station.

emergency_details: A 24-inch surge tank inlet line cutting (hot work) job was on going, in which the sparks from the grinding cut caused a minor fire on the fire blanket.
action_taken: Fire was extinguished within 10sec by the fire crew on standby with 1 unit of 6kg DCP fire extinguisher.
closure_notes: After the pipe cutting job stopped, the area ground and all fire blankets were wet. The fire crew remain on standby at the location.

emergency_details: An insulation worker, working nearby, accidentally hit the suction MOV of charge pump 121-PA-1001B. Which led to the closure of the suction valve, resulting in loss of suction and subsequent trip of the charge pump on low-low discharge flow. Fire occurred at the following locations: Reactor 121-RB-1001/1002 outlet flange, Reactor effluent exchanger EE-1001 S/S inlet flange and Reactor effluent exchanger EE-1005 S/S outlet flange. The line were having Reactor effluent hydrocarbon liquid at 365 degree C auto ignition temperature.
action_taken: Fire was extinguished by the fire crew and the plant field operator with 2 units of 50kg and 4 units of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher.
closure_notes: After the fire was extinguished, the fire crew immediately replaced all used extinguisher and did a proper checking of the area before returning to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire from the heat exchanger 161-EE-0007 Train-01 which occurred during the feed change of the exchanger.
action_taken: Fire was extinguished by the plant operation team with 2000gpm monitior before the arrival of the fire crew.
closure_notes: After a 360 assessment of the area and all the equipments involved. After the fire crew ensureed the sfatefy, the RSM decleared all clear

emergency_details: Fire from a (Catalyst cooler -no 1 Water circulation pump with tag number 111-PA-1001B) which occurs due to overheating of the pump.
action_taken: Fire was extinguisher before the arrival of the fire crew with 1unit of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher by the operation team.
closure_notes: After the 360 assessments of the area and the equipment involved and the all clear had been decleared by the RSM, the fire crew maintained an after emergency standby at the location before returning to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire from the feed exchanger 121-EE-1005 A/B train-2 as discovered by Mr Ojo Oluwafemi (DPRP Security personnel) and unkown to the plant operators and SIC.
action_taken: Fire was extinguished by Mr Ojo Oluwafemi and his team (DPRP security team) before the arrival of the fire crew with the use of 50kg and 9kg DCP fire extinguisher 1unit each. After which, steam lines were passed to the affected flange by the plant operators.
closure_notes: After a round checking and cooling of the area by the fire crew. The fire extinguishers used were replaced. The fire crew with appliances return to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire broke out from 121-EE-1004 train 2 effluent recycle gas exchanger.
action_taken: The fire crew were already on standby at the location for a fire cover. The crew quickly use 2 lines of hose already laid to put off the fire.
closure_notes: Crew remained on standby at the location.

emergency_details: A minor fire outbreak originated from an IFO line, which caught fire and escalated towards the trench due to the presence of hydrocarbons (HC), resulting in damage to instrument cables.
action_taken: Controlled the fire using 1 x 50kg and 2 x 9kg DCP fire extinguishers. The Fire Team subsequently applied water spray to cool down the affected area and prevent re-ignition.
closure_notes: After the damping down and all area were in good condition. The fire crew with their appliances return to their respective station standby.

emergency_details: A vent Fire that is being caused by a lightning strike involving tank 716-TT-1601A (Isomerate) and 716-TT-1604 A&B (Light RFCC Gasoline)
action_taken: Foam monitors and sprinkler system (cooling rings) were kept operational while 3 units of 6kg and 1 unit of 9 kg DCP fire extinguishers were used to extinguished the Fire by both the Fire team (SFS-04 & MFS) and the Operational team.
closure_notes: After the all clear declaration by the RSM , the fire team did a 360 degree assessment of the tanks area and tested the water line header for appropriate throw before returning to their respective station.

emergency_details: CPP SIC Mr.mathew informed the fire team that was blast on the steam turbine with the tag number (680-FM-1005B), the fire team confirmed the incident and casualty involving 3 power mech and 1 dprp staff.
closure_notes: Fire inspection was carried out by two fire team led by Mr Nilesh and Mr kamran and team returned to their various stations after proper inspection carried out.

emergency_details: A fire emanation from the flange of the train-2 effluent feed exchanger (121-EE-1005A/B).
action_taken: One unit of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher was used to put out the fire by the operational team before the arrival of the Fire team.
closure_notes: After the fire had been extinguished the Fire team maintained an after emergency standby at the location.

emergency_details: A fire outbreak involving a diesel pumping burner of a kitchen at block K-55 belonging to one Sinoma company which reportedly caught fire while about to cook due to excess diesel vapour in the burner. The Fire slightly damaged the pumping diesel burner and the heat exhaust fan was also affected.
action_taken: Two units of 5kg CO2 fire extinguisher was used to put out the fire before the arrival of the Fire team by a chef one Mr Gideon who also sustained a slight injury by broken glass while breaking the door in order to access the Fire extinguisher outside and he was immediately taken to 22k clinic for treatment.
closure_notes: After the fire had been extinguished and the injured personnel had been taken to the clinic for treatment,the fire team retrieved and replaced the two used fire extinguishers and later returned to their station.

emergency_details: An electrical fire confined in the toilet of an unoccupied room.
action_taken: Fire extinguished by the use of one medium jet of water working from FT-10.
closure_notes: After a round inspection, area was cool. All fire crew with appliances return to their station standby.

emergency_details: Fire out on arrival of the fire crew and it was discoved to be a malfunctioning LPD device which resulted into a minor hydrogen fire in the area.
action_taken: Fire extinguisher by the operational personnel on duty with 1 unit of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher.
closure_notes: The maintance personnel team reoairs the faulty device after removing the ZY valve. After a completed inspection round the plant by the fire. The fire crew return to their station station standby.

emergency_details: An electrical fire.
action_taken: Unpon arrival the crew immediately lay a length of hose from FT-10 to jet off the fire.
closure_notes: After a propare ventilation and inspection of the area. The fire crew with appliances return to their respective station standby.

emergency_details: Fire from the Flange of Heat exchanger 121-EE-1004 (Train 2 effluent recycle gas exchanger) while the fire team were on standby for Shutdown of Effluent Feed Exchanger for rectifying of issue around the area by Mechanical team.
action_taken: Fire extinguished with a deployed Hose line from from the nearest hydrant to contain and cool the affected area.
closure_notes: After cooling off the equipment. The fire crew continue with the ongoing shutdown standby.

emergency_details: Fire involving the expander inlet at the south side of RFCC.
action_taken: Before the arrival of the fire crew, 4uints of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher were used by the plant operational team. The fire crew on arrival, immediately lay a line of hose divided into two stream, from the hydrant to completely put off the fire.
closure_notes: The fire crew remain on standby while the Plant Operational team introduce a steam line to the equipment for cooling.

emergency_details: Smoke log with no flame of fire from one of the air blower with number SBR AIR BLOWER 621-BL 1001E (250HW, 40A) (VFD) which got heated and generated smoke. This lead to the activation of 42 smoke detectors from the fire panel. And shut down of the fire pump house Electric pumps.
action_taken: On arrival of the fire crew, the use the ventilation method of letting the smoke out by opening of all windows and doors.
closure_notes: After a close observation of the area, the fire crew stayed for a while why monitoing the maintenance team as they fix the affected panel. The fire crew return to their respective standby stations after the power was restored and the area were in good conditions.

emergency_details: Fire confined into the toilet of Room-01 Block M-03.
action_taken: On arrival of the fire crew, the first prevent the fire from spreading across other rooms and using hose reel from the fire truck to put-out the fire.
closure_notes: It was observed that, there were no power supply to the facility and the suspected cause of fire is ARSON. After a round checking and the area were in good condition, the fire crew with appliance return to their respective station standby.

emergency_details: An open fire occurred at exchanger 121-EE-1004 Train 2 Effluent Recycle Gas Exchanger.
action_taken: On arrival of the fire crew they extinguished the fire using Hydrant MHC FM-08 from the fire truck strategically positioned near the work location.
closure_notes: The crew remain on standby at the location due to the foreseeable potential for the fire during the normal operation.

emergency_details: A vent fire from hydrocarbon vapor vent pipe on the tank 716-TT-1601A ISOMERATE due to lightning strike.
action_taken: A 2000GPM Foam monitor at the west side of the tank was activated and 1 unit of 6kg DCP fire extinguisher was used to extinguish the fire due to the limitations of the throw from the monitor, which could not reach the rooftop of the tank.
closure_notes: After the all clear was declared by Mr Gowdhaman SIC Zone C and a thorough assessment of the location had been carried out, the fire team returned their respective station for standby.

emergency_details: A fire outbreak from a drain pipe attached to tank 712-TT-1202C SR NAPHTHA.
action_taken: 1unit of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher was used to extinguish the fire by Mr Micheal a field operator before the arrival of the fire team
closure_notes: A thorough inspection was carried out around the area by the fire team to rule out reignition before left the location for their respective station.

emergency_details: Minor fire from the exchanger flange outlet of Effluent gas exchanger 121-EE-1004
action_taken: It was obserevd while fire crew were on standby and immediately extinguished it using a medium size jet.
closure_notes: After the dawping down, the fire crew remain on standby.

emergency_details: A leakage of natural gas from the outlet flange of Feed Gas PRE-HTR, 161-EE-007 which resulted to a minor FIRE outbreak.
action_taken: Before the arrival of the fire crew, the plant operational team made use 10units of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher. The fire crew immediately connected a line of hose to the a nearby riser to completely put-off the fire.
closure_notes: After the fire had been put off, the operational team isolated the line from the gas supply source while the fire crew stayed on standby for after emergency.

emergency_details: Fire from the exchanger flange outlet of Effluent gas exchanger 121-EE-1004
action_taken: Fire was extinguished with one medium size jet and trailer manted monitor.
closure_notes: The fire crew after cooling and dawping the area. The fire crew remain on standby.

emergency_details: Fire caused by miscreats burning cable for recovery of copper
action_taken: Fire was put off with water by the crew.

emergency_details: Fire on a vent line.
action_taken: Fire was put off by directing a streamline fog from the nearest monitor.
closure_notes: The operators shut the vent line, the fire crew carried out a round check on the area before returning to their station standby.

emergency_details: Minor fire from the exchanger flange outlet of Effluent gas exchanger 121-EE-1004
action_taken: Fire out before the arrival of the fire crew by the plant operational team using 1000GPM monitor.
closure_notes: After a 360 check of the area, the fire crew remain on standby while the maintenance and operation works continue.

emergency_details: Fire confined to a pot on a gas cooker
action_taken: The fire crew broke the entrace glass door to gain access into the building. Gas supply was shut from the supply cylinder outside.
closure_notes: Fire was smothered with a lid and the pot taken to a safe place to cool off. The kitchen was ventilated and handed over to the security team.

emergency_details: Fire confined in a power distribution panel as a result of overload.
action_taken: Fire out before the arrival of the fire crew by the electrical team.
closure_notes: After inspection of the area. The fire crew with appliance return to their station standby.

emergency_details: A minor fire from the 121-EE-1004 Effluent Recycle Gas exchanger outlet flange MHC as a result of Hot surface ignition.
action_taken: Immediately the fire crew on standby brought it under control with the use of 1000GPM monitor.
closure_notes: Fire crew remian on standby as a result of the reoccurance of the fire.

emergency_details: A fire occurred on the shell side of exchanger 152-EE-1008,First located on the east side the plant during maintenance de-blinding activities. The product involved is hydrogen.
action_taken: The fire team succesfully extiguished the fire and the operation team subsequently injected nitrogen into the exchanger to inert the system and prevent any re-ignition.
closure_notes: After the situation had been brought under control and all clear being decleared the fire team remain on standby to monitor the area and ensure safe conditions. The incident is being closely monitored.

emergency_details: A fire involving hydrogen from the outlet flange of feed exchanger's TAG NO:-152-EU-1001 at 3rd floor, CCR area of MSB
action_taken: A line of hose was deployed from FT-4 and nearby hydrant, also four units of 9kg DCP fire extinguishers were used to brought the fire under control.
closure_notes: After the situation had been brought under control and all clear being decleared the fire team maintained an after emergency standby to monitor the area and prevent any form of re-ignition.

emergency_details: A Sudden blast that occurred on one panel 155-PA-1012A(K-11) that led to the first floor of SS-03 panel room to be engulfed with smoke.
action_taken: The electrical line was isolated immediately before the arrival of the fire team by an electrical operator one Engineer Abdulraman. On arrival of the fire team ventilation activity was carried extract the smoke.
closure_notes: After the all clear by the MSB SIC, the fire team remain on standby for any reoccurrence.

emergency_details: A Hydrogen fire confined into a transmitter line flange of first stage suction volume bottle in a compressor 121-KA-1002A MUG-A which the tempertaure was at 100 degree C and the pressure was about 22kg.
action_taken: The fire crew swift into action by deploying of 1unit of 9kg DCP, 5kg CO2 and 1000gmp fixed foam monitor to suppress the fire.
closure_notes: After the fire was put out, the crew replaced the used fire extinguisher. All clear was declear by the SIC Mr Anand Rao. All fire crew with appliance return to their station standby.

emergency_details: A spark which emanated from the engine compartment of a Chevrolet Aveo Car driven by one Mr. Edito Anto.
action_taken: The fire was put out before the arrival of the the fire team by the security personnel on ground with the use 1 unit of 3KG CO2 Fire extinguisher from the CSO office and 1 unit of 2KG DCP Fire extinguisher from the car. The fire team ensured to cool the engine compartment with water as smoke was still visibly seen coming out from the Air Conditioner Hose in the Engine Compartment.
closure_notes: After the situation was fully under control and the Shift Lead declared All Clear, the fire team returned to their standby location.

emergency_details: A fire outbreak involving a turbine pump 634-PA-1001B at the Cooling Tower-04
action_taken: The fire had been put off before arrival of fire team by operational personnel with the use of 2 units of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher and 1 unit 5kg CO2 fire extinguisher.
closure_notes: After the situation was fully under control and the all clear had been decleared, the fire team replaced the used fire extinguishers and returned to tjeir standby location.

emergency_details: A smoke was discovered from the chassis close to welded metal plate of the engine area of a 45,000 litres PMS truck with registration number BDJ 827 ZY, which belong to OYEE COMPANY ,driven by Mr Lukman Sanusi.
action_taken: The smoke was put off before arrival of fire team by the operational team with the use of 2 units of 9kg DCP fire extinguisher.
closure_notes: After the situation was fully under control and the all clear had been decleared, the fire team replaced the used fire extinguishers and maintained a standby at gantry during the decanting process.

emergency_details: A fire outbreak originated from the first room right of the north entrance of Block 4, 10K staff apartment. The fire later spread to the second and third room right as well as to the roof.The cause of the fire was expected to be a POWER SURGE.
action_taken: The fire was put out with a line of hose from FT-09 and FT-06 each. Ventilation was carried out with the use of smoke extractor. Although before the arrival of the fire crew the occupatants of the building already used 3 units of 3kg CO2 fire extinguishers to fight the fire.
closure_notes: The used fire extinguishers were replace.The fire crew return to their station standby after the fire is put out completely.

emergency_details: It was an emergency involving Mr Timloh Joshua from HR TECH contractor who was carrying out arc welding job inside 113-EE-1021B Debutanizer Trim Condenser which exploded due to presence of hydrocarbon in the condenser.
action_taken: The victim sustain slight injury on his face and nose, He was handed over to SFS-03 ambulance for medical attention at the gate.
closure_notes: The job was suspended by the RSM till further notice. After the area was confrimed to be in good condition and the victim taken to the madical center. The fire crew with their appliance return to their station standby.

location_clean: NEW OFFSHORE WORKSHOP, OPPOSITE SOUTH SIDE OF PPU
emergency_details: An electrical spark involving an under ground cable that was sparking intermittently.
action_taken: The sparks stopped before the arrival of Fire team, Fire team carefully checked and traced the underground cable wire which was known to have brought up from underground by the tractors working around the place. The electrical personnel immediately swung into action by isolating the power supply to the area and rectified the said cable after which the power was restored back without any traces of electrical sparks within the area again.
closure_notes: Fire team rechecked and confirmed the situation was brought under control without any traces of electrical sparks or fire outbreak and the shift lead declaered all clear while the team returned to their standby location.
location_raw: New offshore workshop, opposite South side of PPU

emergency_details: The fire crew on arrival at the scene,it was observed to be a Toyota Hilux with reg.number MNA-328HK belong to city car hire, which caught fire while on motion from the front tiyer driver side as a result of unknown fault.
action_taken: The fire was put out by the fire crew using 2uints of 6kg DCP fire extinguishers and water from FT-09 was used for the cooling. The vehicle was handed over to DPRP security team lead by Mr Bolus.
closure_notes: In attendance were, the fire crew and DPRP security team.
